name: services
description: Search the catalog to discover exact service IDs and categories. Uses the UptimeScout license and its normal quota. Read observed_at, stale and region before describing availability. Missing or stale data is unknown.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Collected ISO observation country, for example GB, DE or JP. Independent of interface language.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search service name or ID.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Exact category value returned by the service catalog.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter normalized signals; unknown also covers stale or unavailable observations.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Use next_offset to continue; do not request repeated first pages.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset returned as next_offset.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of service descriptions. Responses include description_language and a versioned own-domain logo_url.

name: status
description: Read the latest saved regional observation for one service. Uses the UptimeScout license and its normal quota. Read observed_at, stale and region before describing availability. Missing or stale data is unknown.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Exact service ID returned by uptimescout_services, for example github.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Collected ISO observation country, for example GB, DE or JP. Independent of interface language.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of service descriptions. Responses include description_language and a versioned own-domain logo_url.

name: statuses
description: Read several service statuses in one quota-counted batch request. Uses the UptimeScout license and its normal quota. Read observed_at, stale and region before describing availability. Missing or stale data is unknown.

parameters.name: services
parameters.description: Comma-separated service IDs from the catalog, for example github,cloudflare. Batch maximum depends on the license.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Collected ISO observation country, for example GB, DE or JP. Independent of interface language.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of service descriptions. Responses include description_language and a versioned own-domain logo_url.
